tasks.brief:
Project: /tmp/v5orch/w/t2 (Node/TypeScript, `npm test` runs node:test on test/*.test.ts). Fix exactly one bug in src/pricing.ts so the failing test "applyDiscount takes a whole percentage" passes.

Facts: applyDiscount is `return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct));` but its doc comment says: "pct is a whole percentage: applyDiscount(1000, 10) === 900." The test asserts applyDiscount(1000, 10) === 900 and applyDiscount(1000, 0) === 1000. The bug is that pct is not divided by 100.

Scope: edit ONLY src/pricing.ts. Do not edit any test file or any other file. Do not special-case tests. Do not run other fixes. Keep the change minimal. When done, reply with the one-line diff you made and the output of `node --test test/pricing.test.ts` from /tmp/v5orch/w/t2.
